desc: Implement BFS from S and from T to compute dS[1..N] and dT[1..N].
Implement Tarjan's bridge-finding / biconnected-component decomposition to identify all blocks that contain at least one cycle (size ≥ 3 or more than one edge inside the block).
If no cyclic block exists, print -1 and terminate.
For each vertex v in a cyclic block, update the answer with 2*dS[v] + 2*dT[v] + 4.

For each cyclic block, compute the minimum over distinct vertices x, y in the block (or over edges/cycles within the block) of 2*dS[x] + 2*dT[y] + shortest_cycle_length_containing_x_y; update the answer accordingly.
Validate the implementation against the provided samples and test edge cases (tree graph, single cycle, cycle with tails).
